observations.body: Paul recalls boldness, work, gentleness, and fatherly appeal. For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain, to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

payload.posture: Read 1 Thessalonians 2:1–12 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul recalls boldness, work, gentleness, and fatherly appeal. For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain, to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
